title: World, Scene, Combat, Exploration & Creator Integration

resolution_required: exact handoff from MAI-08 presentation-authoring draft snapshots/receipts into existing owner-domain commands or references
World/location/topology/navigation integration that preserves MIB-11/D18 authority and does not infer World truth from artwork or draft geometry
Scene/Tabletop integration for runtime layer/object placement and mutation without letting authoring drafts become live state by implication
Visibility/Permissions integration for audience visibility, hidden state, occlusion authorization and line-of-sight without bypass
Combat/Exploration integration for collision, cover, movement, interaction, triggers, portals and consequences without promoting visual hints to gameplay truth
D29/creator publication and provenance handoff with explicit approval/version/provenance boundaries
failure/rollback/reconciliation behavior when a draft is stale, unresolved, unpermitted or conflicts with current owner state
deterministic integration receipts/evidence and exact persistence delta, if any, before migration 0022 can be reserved
selection_contract.integration_rule: MAI-09 must integrate by explicit owner seams and commands/references; MAI-08 draft state is input evidence/intent, not authority to overwrite current owner truth.
selection_contract.permission_rule: MAI-07/08 permission and unresolved evidence remains binding at integration time; stale, denied, unknown or revoked authority must fail closed rather than being silently published or activated.
selection_contract.creator_rule: Creator workflows may propose and submit presentation integration intent, but D29 publication/provenance and each runtime owner retain final governed state transitions.
selection_contract.persistence_rule: Selection does not reserve migration 0022. Any durable schema delta must be freshly demonstrated and governed during MAI-09 start/implementation.

preserved_boundaries: MAI-01..08 completed evidence remains binding and cannot be silently discarded
MAI-08 presentation-authoring drafts are integration inputs only
no vendor/editor/provider becomes canonical Multiversal truth
no asset pack is assumed complete and unresolved/placeholder/manual states remain explicit
permission and semantic compatibility are not inferred
MIB-11/D18, D29, Scene/Tabletop, Visibility/Permissions and Combat/Exploration retain owner truth until exact integration seams are resolved
MAI-09 may implement only after a future governed start
migration 0022 remains unreserved absent demonstrated durable schema delta
no real-money commerce, tester distribution, release/deployment or provider/payment activation
next_action: Selection only. On the next owner Continue, freshly verify canonical heads, re-read completed MAI-01..08 and current owner contracts, resolve the exact World/Scene/Visibility/Combat/D29/creator integration seams plus rollback/reconciliation/persistence boundaries, then governed-start MAI-09. Until then do not create an implementation branch or integrate draft output into live owner domains.
